ctaHeading: Start Your Woodworking Journey in Yarraville
aboutText: Swiss Woodcraft is your go-to destination for woodworking education in Yarraville. Under the guidance of experienced instructor Michael Gasser, participants learn practical skills from veneering basics to joint building. Our classes are designed to build confidence and competence in a supportive setting, right here in the heart of Yarraville. With a focus on safety and craftsmanship, we ensure every student gains valuable hands-on experience.
servicesText: Swiss Woodcraft provides a range of classes in Yarraville, from beginners to those enhancing their skills. Each session is hands-on, focusing on real techniques used in woodworking and furniture making. Join us to discover the joy of crafting with wood.

services.title: Veneering Fundamentals for Beginners
services.desc: Learn the basics of wood veneering, including selection, cutting, and application techniques in our Yarraville studio.

services.title: Becoming Handy at Home
services.desc: Develop essential DIY woodworking skills for home projects, taught with practical tips and guidance in Yarraville.

services.title: Hand Tool Techniques
services.desc: Master the use of traditional hand tools like chisels and planes for precise woodworking projects.

services.title: Building with Joints
services.desc: Explore various joint methods from basic to advanced, crucial for sturdy furniture construction in our classes.

services.title: Introduction to Safe Machine Use
services.desc: Get trained on machinery safety and operation, ensuring confidence in the workshop environment at Yarraville.

services.title: Woodworking Workshops
services.desc: General sessions covering multiple aspects of woodworking, tailored to group learning and skill development.
